scope: stable common Writer operations supported by the current HarmonyOS WPS UI automation path

operations.label: NEW_DOCUMENT
operations.description: Create and open a blank Writer document
operations.input_method: WPS new menu > Writer blank document

operations.label: SAVE_DOCUMENT
operations.description: Save changes to an existing document path

operations.label: CLOSE_DOCUMENT
operations.description: Close the current document while keeping WPS alive

operations.label: SELECT_ALL
operations.description: Select all content in the current Writer document

operations.label: PASTE_SELECTION
operations.description: Paste the copied selection at the current cursor

operations.label: UNDO_EDIT
operations.description: Undo the immediately preceding controlled edit

operations.label: FIND_TEXT
operations.description: Open Find, search a controlled token, and close the panel

operations.label: REPLACE_TEXT
operations.description: Open Replace and replace one controlled token

operations.label: INSERT_PAGE_BREAK
operations.description: Insert a page break at the current cursor

operations.label: INSERT_TABLE
operations.description: Insert a controlled 2x2 table through Insert > Table
operations.input_method: WPS Insert tab and table grid

operations.label: FORMAT_BOLD
operations.description: Apply bold formatting to the current selection

operations.label: FORMAT_ITALIC
operations.description: Apply italic formatting to the current selection

operations.label: FORMAT_UNDERLINE
operations.description: Apply underline formatting to the current selection
